leadText:
Mickey (Japanese: ミキ Miki) is a character of the day who appeared in Ariados, Amigos. She is a student at the Pokémon Jujitsu Academy.

Mickey took the Red classes of the Academy which studies battle techniques. She had a battle with and lost.
